name: ArenaArea - Default (seed v1)
description: A battleground, spectator area or lobby of an arena (arena duels rev. 6): the arena's own sub-structure, not a domain, so it has no enter/leave message, discovery or /navigate. Opened from the arena's last step with the arena filled in. Save it, then Edit it to add its regions.

steps.description: What the area is for. A battleground hosts one match at a time; the spectator area is where players watch; the lobby is where the two duelists warm up (one per arena).

fields.label: Arena
fields.description: The arena this area belongs to. An area can't move to another arena.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: BATTLEGROUND, SPECTATOR or LOBBY. Fields of another kind are cleared on save; the kind can't change while the area has regions.

fields.label: Key
fields.description: Unique within the arena, e.g. bg1, stands, lobby.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Optional label for menus and the boss bar, e.g. 'North pit' (at most 64 characters). Empty = the key.

fields.label: Order
fields.description: Battlegrounds are allocated in this order; the first enabled spectator area is where [Spectate] teleports to.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off = not used. A battleground can only be enabled with both spawns and at least one region (add the regions after the first save); the lobby of an arena open for duels must stay enabled.

steps.description: Battlegrounds only: where the two duelists start the countdown. Stand on each spot in game, facing the opponent's spawn, and use Send to Minecraft. Must be in the world of one of the area's regions.

Spectator areas and the lobby: where a teleport lands. The lobby's arrival is where both duelists warm up (needed before duels can be turned on); a spectator area's is where [Spectate] lands (without one the stands are reached on foot only). The title and gem price apply to the spectate teleport only, never to walking in.

fields.label: Arrival location
fields.description: Where the lobby teleport or the spectate teleport lands.

fields.label: Minimum title to spectate
fields.description: Spectator areas only. Optional: the title a player needs for the spectate teleport.

fields.label: Spectate price (gems)
fields.description: Spectator areas only. Optional: gems charged once the spectate teleport's warmup succeeded (refunded if it doesn't happen).

steps.description: The area's WorldGuard regions; the area is their union, so a duelist can cross between two parts of one battleground. Save the area first (Submit), then Edit it to add them. Each is renamed arena_<arena id>_<kind>_<id> when saved.

fields.label: Regions
fields.description: One entry per region; draw each in game.
